title: STARCOM Delt 1 Enlisted Initial Skills Training
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.SPACE TRAINING AND READINESS COMMAND.FA2549 STARCOM CONTRACTING PK
detail_text: THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) ONLY. This is not a Request for Proposal (RFP) or request for competitive quotes. The sole purpose of this RFI is for conducting market research and information collection/dissemination only. Furthermore, under no circumstance shall the Government be liable for any costs associated with providing information in response to this RFI. Any information submitted in response to this RFI is strictly voluntary and will become the property of the U.S. Government. Should questions arise, the Government reserves the right to answer all, some, or none of the questions submitted in response to this RFI. The contractor shall develop, instruct, and maintain an Enlisted Initial Skills Training course for Guardian Space-Domain Fundamentals; Space Systems Operations (5S); Intelligence (5I), and Cyberspace Operations (5C). The effort also includes Mission Integration, Exercises, and Capstone Events, as well as training support and modeling and simulation.
